Brisk but excellent food in a lovely location.
Aug 2026 • Family
I enjoyed two excellent dinners here with my family while staying across the road at the Park Hyatt. The food really is very well done, and the menu is varied enough that a repeat visit was a joy not a trial. The only negative point - if at all - is that service is quick, so you can't have a 'languid' meal. The four of us were in and out in an hour both times, but as we were with teenage boys, that wasn't a problem - but maybe you'd not come here for a romantic two-some! But a lovely location and great food.

Our best Dining experience in Siagon
Sep 2026 • Couples
The food was fantastic, the restaurant was packed, we were walk ins and the staff could not help enough. The front of house staff assisted us with our selections and the shared appetiser platter was really fantastic. 

They then assisted with ordering mains which included a divine prawn and squid dish served with tea leaves which were a highlight of the dish.

Then a sea bass with pineapple which was beautifully presented and very tasty.
 
We had some traditional Vietnamese deserts which included mung beans which we would never order however recommended by the staff. They were very different to us however the flavours and textures were really beautiful and would definitely order again.

The service was very attentive and prompt. The table next to us was on the third sitting as we were leaving.

The kitchen obviously highly talented and very well organised as food service was prompt. 

The location was walking distance from hotel on the river and will be close to everywhere and transport is really good value on the Grab although we did walk most places. 

This was fourth dinner we had in Siagon and whilst it cost a little more it was really good value for money and this restaurant was easily the best of the four on every measurement.

Not to the owners Google our online maps took us to the incorrect place as the restaurant is situated back off the street in a well lite walkway. It has obviously happened before as the security at the hotel where we were directed advised us to head down the road and turn right and right so it has happened before.

We are so happy we found the Hoa Tuc in Siagon and will definitely go next time as there were easily 7 or 8 things on the menu that we would be happy to have.
Read more
Insider tip:
We were walk ins and lucky to get a table. Worth while making a booking. Google maps takes you to the wrong place even with correct address.
